_note: Fiducial-marked props for a live CSP-1 run without trained detector weights (parikshak/perception/markers.py). Print each tag at exactly tag_size_m (black square edge) and fix it to the prop, facing the camera. A state is a tag too: fit the 'closed' and 'open' tags so that only the one matching the prop's real state can be seen. IDs 201+ never clash with the rack fiducials (101-104), and CRX-2 uses the same IDs, so one printed set serves both procedures.
